description: Rescale ZPL between printer resolutions (203/300/600 DPI): coordinates, fonts, barcode module width and label size are scaled. Embedded ^GF/~DG image data is NOT scaled; the response says so instead of silently passing it through.

source_dpi.description: Resolution the ZPL was written for, in DPI (not dpmm: 203 DPI = 8 dpmm).

target_dpi.description: Resolution to rescale to, in DPI. Equal to source_dpi means no scaling.

name: convert_zpl_dpi
title: Convert ZPL DPI
